correctness.rationale: The dyadic cell induction is exact for almost every base point, and independent uniform ternary digits give a reflected birth-death chain. Conditional expectation yields \(E_{n+1}-E_n=-a_n/3\). Renewal gives \(A(w)=2/(1-2w/3+\sqrt{1-8w^2/9})\) and \(A(1)=3\), proving the tail formula. Nonnegative coefficients bound the renewal denominator strictly from zero through the convergence circle; Puiseux expansions at both \(\pm3/(2\sqrt2)\), the binomial coefficient transfer formula and summable geometric tails give the sharp parity-dependent asymptotic including an \(O(1/n)\) relative correction. The exact-rational check reproduces \(3^n\) separately propagated cells for \(n\le8\), coefficients to \(n=22\), and the large-step scale. No inference from finite experiments to the theorem is made.

value.rationale: The full-fiber ensemble width is a natural dynamical measure of unresolved center information after n steps. The source proves only qualitative a.e. collapse and its typical Lyapunov scale; the exact mean speed is controlled by rare near-balanced excursions and differs exponentially from the typical fiber contraction. The exact rate, \(n^{-3/2}\) prefactor and positive parity-resolved constants make a quantitative sharp transition from pointwise to ensemble synchronization, motivating the precise expectation rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
